name: Henry's Fork (Big Springs Water Trail)

gaugeContext.note: No suitable current flow gauge is assigned to this water-trail reach. The Big Springs station is discontinued; nearby lake-release and below-reservoir readings do not represent this spring-fed float. Access information and the published planning distance remain available.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS — Big Springs at Big Springs, station 13040500

timing.note: No reviewed live-flow travel-speed model or guide time specific to this public takeout is assigned. Historical whole-trail times include other takeouts and are retained as research only.

blurb: A popular spring-fed water trail near Island Park, from the hand-carry launch at the old railroad trestle to the public Forest Service takeout above Mack’s Inn. Keep the public takeout distinct from private bridge-side landings.

sections.takeOut: Big Springs Water Trail Public Takeout
sections.notes: A spring-fed meadow float for hand-carried boats. Launch at the trestle-side water-trail facility and finish at the designated public takeout upstream of Mack’s Inn bridge. Arrange your shuttle and identify the clearing before launching; private resort and cabin landings are different sites.

distanceEvidence.note: The local outfitter guide describes a 3.9-mile float ending at the public takeout upstream of Highway 20. Other guides describe the broader bridge-side destination as 4–4.5 miles. This approximate planning distance is not a surveyed landing-to-landing measurement; source geometry for the spring branch is incomplete.

notices.title: Hand-carry launch; public takeout before the bridge
notices.text: Use the water-trail dock/stairs and the designated public takeout. Bridge-side businesses and cabin docks are separate access arrangements. This itinerary does not continue into Coffee Pot Rapids.
notices.sourceName: Henry’s Fork Foundation / Caribou-Targhee National Forest — water-trail field study

notices.title: Fishing closed on the upper spring reach
notices.text: Idaho’s 2025–2027 rules close fishing from the head of Big Springs downstream to Henrys Lake Outlet. Check the current rules before fishing farther downstream.
notices.sourceName: Idaho Fish and Game — Big Springs fishing rules
